subject.title: fix(acp): preserve structured exec approval metadata

question: When a structured exec approval supplies a toolCallId that does not produce a unique active match, should ACP retain the existing unique-session fallback or refuse to bind the approval?
rationale: The fallback preserves established single-session and early-event behavior, while exact supplied-identifier matching offers a stricter approval-correlation boundary; repository intent is needed to choose that invariant.

options.title: Preserve bounded fallback
options.body: Keep the proposed behavior: prefer a unique sessionKey-plus-toolCallId match, then use the existing unique-session fallback when it remains unambiguous.

options.title: Require exact identifier match
options.body: Treat a supplied but unmatched toolCallId as authoritative and drop the approval rather than falling back to session-only correlation.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed behavior: prefer a unique sessionKey-plus-toolCallId match, then use the existing unique-session fallback when it remains unambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ACP permission-relay path whose correlation behavior is being changed.
